default/30703.htm.text: Hunters Guild Member Colin: Hey, you look familiar! What brings you to the Hunters Guild? Are you here to join the guild? Well, we aren't accepting any new members. Or could it be that you are here for something else? Ask anything, I will attempt to answer your questions with the utmost respect.

links.text: Tell me about the Hunters Guild.
Tell me about the geographical features of the village.
Where is a good place to hunt?
